flags: Nudge Security's profile lists Dubverse as SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, FedRAMP, and CSA STAR Level 1 compliant. None of these certifications are documented or mentioned on Dubverse's own website (privacy policy, terms, ethics, or enterprise pages).
Not to be confused with 'Dubber' (dubber.net). Dubverse is Lensmatic Solutions Private Limited, founded 2021, India-based.
Founded in 2021 with $800K funding (Kalaari Capital). Enterprise security documentation is minimal compared to mature vendors.
The privacy policy mentions 'commercially reasonable measures' for encryption but does not specify TLS/SSL, AES, or other cryptographic standards.
Unlike mature SaaS vendors, Dubverse has no standalone trust center, compliance dashboard, or audit report repository.
Data is stored in Mumbai, India; compliant with Indian IT laws but with no explicit mention of additional international compliance audits.
Relative to enterprise SaaS vendors, compliance documentation is straightforward and minimal, consistent with the company's stage.
